Asal sale = bill − wapsi (void bill nahi: Net sale = bills − returns (void bills are not counted). Cost = cost when the bill was made; if no cost was written, today's cost. Expenses only once paid (not pending). Net profit = profit − expenses − damaged, lost or missing stock. A return counts on the day of the bill it came from. Reports, Profit report, Profit & loss and Dashboard all use this. Only the "Returns" tab and the Day report show returns on the day they happened.

Real sale = bills − returns (void bills are not counted). Cost = cost when the bill was made; if no cost was entered, today's cost. Only expenses already paid count (not pending). Net profit = profit − expenses − damaged, lost or short-counted stock. A return counts on the day of the bill its goods came from. Reports, Profit report, Profit-loss and Dashboard all use this same math. Here salary and commission also show as their own line, and advance kept from cancelled bookings is added to income.
